candidates.name: West-East Pipeline
candidates.from: interior/western Abu Dhabi onshore oil fields (Habshan area)
candidates.to: Fujairah (Port of Fujairah, Gulf of Oman)

evidence.note: Sheikh Khaled announces acceleration of new ADNOC pipeline project to double Fujairah bypass export capacity, targeting 2027; distinct from existing ADCOP (Habshan-Fujairah, 380km, ~1.5Mbd, operating since 2012).

Names it 'West-East Pipeline', ~300km, ~$3bn cost, would raise Fujairah bypass capacity from 1.8 to 3+ Mbd; ~50% complete per reports, targeting early/mid-2027 start; would carry Upper Zakum, Das Blend, Umm Lulu crude streams.

Confirms 'West-East Pipeline project', 48-inch diameter, 1.5mn b/d capacity, connects interior Abu Dhabi fields to Fujairah, under construction, operational 2027; combined with existing Habshan-Fujairah line would reach ~3.3mn b/d total.

ADNOC CEO Sultan Al Jaber quoted: project 'already almost 50% complete,' accelerating delivery toward 2027; refers to it as 'West-East Pipeline' / 'Hormuz Bypass Pipeline', complementary to (not replacing) existing Habshan-Fujairah line.
Refers to project as 'West-East 1 Pipeline'; will double ADNOC's Fujairah export capacity; operational target 2027; under development following UAE's May 2026 OPEC departure.
SPE/JPT trade coverage: new pipeline running parallel to the existing ~250-mile (Habshan-)Fujairah line, combined capacity ~3.6 million b/d once complete; ~50% complete, targeting 2027 start.

Confirms 'West-East pipeline expansion' name and 2027 operational target doubling Fujairah export capacity; this piece's length/diameter figures (360km, 48in) appear to restate the existing ADCOP line's specs rather than the new line's, so not relied on for new-line length here.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row reflects a second, under-construction crude line parallel to ADCOP on the Habshan-Fujairah corridor. Closest existing entry is P0553 (Bab-Habshan-Jebel Dhanna Oil Pipeline aka Abu Dhabi Crude Oil Pipeline/ADCOP; Habshan-Fujairah Oil Pipeline; status=operating; len=406.0; dia=48; cap=1,800,000) — same general corridor/purpose (Habshan-area fields to Fujairah, bypassing Hormuz) but that row is the pre-existing, fully operating 2012-commissioned line. This 2026-announced 'West-East'/'West-East 1' project is a separate, currently-under-construction parallel pipeline (~300km per Kpler vs. ADCOP's 406km; ~50% built as of May 2026, targeting 2027 commissioning) intended to roughly double the corridor's total bypass capacity — it is not simply a re-description of P0553 and should be entered as a new construction-status row, cross-referenced to P0553 as the parallel/existing line. No dedicated new trunk pipeline tied to Fujairah terminal works (beyond this West-East line and terminal/storage expansion) was found.
